notes: Refreshed goal-desk-iter-33 by browser-qa-agent (assigned in the iteration's Golden replay script maintenance section). The previous version of this script pinned three now-superseded exact values from the topup-2026-07-29-5de907c83fc4 run: the counts line '0 reused . 390 fetched . 0 unchanged . 14 failed', the WINDOW_BASIS_NOT_RECORDED fallback text at step 3, and a 'Failed pairs (14)' block at step 4. A NEW real top-up run landed on the ambient store between iter-32 and iter-33 (topup-2026-07-31-8fb5c9a1f737, 404/404 pairs attempted, verified live 2026-07-31): it now carries '0 reused . 404 fetched . 0 unchanged . 0 failed', a REAL recorded window_basis ('390 pairs asked for a tail window . 14 pairs asked for the full lookback window' -- so the WINDOW_BASIS_NOT_RECORDED fallback no longer renders), and zero failed pairs (so the 'Failed pairs' block does not mount at all -- failedOutcomes.length > 0 gates it in apps/frontend/app/desk/page.tsx's LatestTopupRunDetail). This is the same class of honest environmental drift J-09.json's and J-18.json's own notes document for their asserted run stats -- not a product regression. The literal J-17 acceptance line 'at least one unchanged ... one failed pair' describes the run that existed when J-17 was ORIGINALLY built (iter-27/28); the current ambient run genuinely has full coverage and zero failures, which this script now asserts honestly instead of pinning stale counts.

This replay script is DELIBERATELY READ-ONLY (goto/expect only, no click on 'Top-up') so it never triggers a new ~100-symbol walk against the live Yahoo adapter -- the J-09/J-18 precedent: that button is reserved for an explicit, separately-reported operator act, never an automated regression lane.

Step 2 asserts the stable STRUCTURE of the four-outcome counts line ('fetched', the literal word, which every run -- real or fixture -- renders) rather than pinning the exact numbers, which drift on every real ambient run.

Step 3 asserts the window-basis line renders a REAL recorded value ('asked for a tail window') rather than the WINDOW_BASIS_NOT_RECORDED fallback -- proving window_basis is present on this run, without pinning the exact tail/full-lookback split.

Step 4 is a post-match liveness re-check (the J-09.json/J-18.json precedent), replacing the old 'Failed pairs (14)' assertion that cannot mount against a run with zero failures: a further /desk navigation after the key text match, proving the page is still alive and rendering correctly.
